name: Christmas Community
description: A simple place for your entire family to use to find gifts that people want and avoid double-gifting.

variables.name: Enable Public Lists
variables.description: Allow viewing wishlists without logging in

variables.name: Enable Single List Mode
variables.description: Limit to only one list (only the admin account's list). Useful for weddings, birthdays, etc.

variables.name: Use Table Mode
variables.description: true - Use table layout, false - use legacy card layout

variables.name: Site Title
variables.description: Title of the site, displayed on page and navigation bar

variables.name: Short Site Title
variables.description: Short title of the site, used when shared to home screen

variables.name: Allow Markdown in notes
variables.description: Allow markdown in notes. Does not work when Table Mode is disabled.

variables.name: Show Available Update Notices
variables.description: Check for updates and show a notice if an update is available.

variables.name: Enable Profile Pictures
variables.description: Enable profile pictures.

variables.name: Bulmaswatch Theme
variables.description: Bulmaswatch theme to use: https://jenil.github.io/bulmaswatch.

variables.name: Database location
variables.description: Internal (in container) database location

variables.name: Web Server Port
variables.description: Port to run the web server on. Not recommended to change.

variables.name: Expose Database Port
variables.description: Expose internal PouchDB port. Mostly for debugging. Leave empty to disable.

variables.name: Proxy server
variables.description: Proxy server to use for requests. Leave empty to disable.

variables.name: Session Cookie Secret
variables.description: Secret to use for session cookies. Leave empty to generate a random secret.

variables.name: Session Max Age
variables.description: Max age of session cookies in milliseconds.

variables.name: Root Path
variables.description: Root path to serve the site from. Useful for proxying.

variables.name: Login Failure Redirect
variables.description: Redirect to this page after a login failure.

variables.name: Proxy Forwarded Trust Source
variables.description: Trust the X-Forwarded-For header from this source. Set to 'loopback' to trust all.

variables.name: Enable Amazon Smile
variables.description: Amazon Smile has been discontinued, set this to false to avoid potential issues.

variables.name: Language
variables.description: Language to use.

author: nwithan8
